[[File:SWGTC_Powered_Armour.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Imperial trooper in power armor attacks a landspeeder]]
'''Power armor''', also called a '''powersuit''', was a type of personal armor that protected an individual from the elements. Powersuits were used by a variety of organizations ranging from militaries to independent explorers. Some powersuits were built to increase the wearer's strength and agility while others served to protect the wearer from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts. Many companies produced a variety of powersuits with the most popular being [[Nova-Tech]], [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], and [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]].
